brief: blind judge on reports/packs/prose-tics-r4/ (quality question, both sides masked)
successor_note: I am the SECOND judge on this task. Rule 3: my status file already existed, so I am a successor. The predecessor recorded outputs_written:[] and state:researching, but ALL FIFTEEN answer.md files were on disk with a PICK and a CONFIDENCE line. Its work was recoverable and is preserved byte-untouched. I restarted no trio and edited nothing in the pack.
procedure_declared_before_reading: 1. Inventory predecessor answers. Confirmed 15/15 have PICK + CONFIDENCE. Preserve them as the committed pre-reveal record (RI-MTH03 M3).
2. CONTAMINATION DECLARED: to inventory them I read the PICK: and CONFIDENCE: lines of all 15 before judging anything myself. My own pass is NOT an independent blind pass and is not reported as one.
3. Did NOT read the predecessor's evidence bullets or WEAKEST POINT before forming my own view on a trio.
4. Did NOT read pack.json (carries a_words/b_words) until after all 15 of my own answers were written.
5. Running record appended trio-by-trio to reports/packs/prose-tics-r4-judgement.md.
6. Reveal opened ONLY after all 15 rows existed on disk. Then scored, then leak audit.

result.reading: Discrimination perfect, preference inverted. Not the RI-MTH03 §E 'critic is not discriminating' failure. Fourteen picked-ours rows fire the mandatory M5 second pass, which is OWED and not run.

verdict: BELOW BAR — BLIND RESULT INADMISSIBLE AS A QUALITY MEASUREMENT (RI-MTH03 M6 override). Process points 16/18 = 89%, but the leak audit found a 15/15 structural tell.
leak_audit_headline: Counting '[NAME-' tokens and picking the file with FEWER identifies our side 15/15 without reading a word. Closest margin 30 vs 40; widest 41 vs 129. Root cause is in the reveal key itself: reference name maps carry 12-57 entries, ours carry 3-25. r1 leaked setting nouns (17/17); r4 masked them and leaks mask density (15/15). Each round's fix creates the next round's tell.
second_leak: The masker drops text, and it drops it on the side with more proper nouns, which is always the reference. Dropped-text proxy fires on the reference in 14/15 trios. The pack degrades one side and then asks which side is better.
predecessor_claim_cleared: The predecessor suspected a length leak (A>B in all books trials). Measured against the key: A >= B in EVERY trio regardless of which side is ours, and ours is shorter in only 4/15. The trimmer uniformly favours A; it carries no provenance information. NOT a leak. Length matching is in fact excellent - eleven trios match to within two words.

trios_i_got_wrong_and_would_change.t02-books: Docked the reference (Charwich-Koniinge Vol. 4) as plot recap in summary. The recap IS the murderer's voice - the letter is dictated by the man who strangled the writer - so the flat chronicle tone is characterisation, not exposition.
trios_i_got_wrong_and_would_change.t03-books: Docked the reference (The Prayers of Baranat) for its closing moral. It caps a hero who has just won a horrible bride and a ruined estate, so it is a joke at his expense, not a lesson for the reader. I read the shape and not the content.

finding_for_the_builder: Our prose has one tic and one voice. The tic is the antithetical restatement ('He does not want the lease audited. He wants it laundered.') in >=9 of 15 samples. The voice - dry, institutional, withholding, aphoristic - is identical whether the speaker is a magistrate, a trader, a rootkeeper or a clerk. Morrowind's dialogue is worse AND more various; ours is better AND monotone.
predecessor_confidence_flag: All 15 predecessor answers were CONFIDENCE: high. A judge certain fifteen times is not judging - though in this pack the sides are so separable that certainty on provenance was warranted; it was misplaced onto the quality question.
rules_conflict_declared: RULES.md rule 28 says 'Do not commit; the orchestrator banks the tree.' My task instruction from the orchestrating agent explicitly directed me to commit to the current branch. I followed the explicit instruction, committed ONLY my four output files, and flag the conflict here and in the verdict rather than resolving it silently. The game/ modifications in the working tree belong to neighbouring agents and were not staged by me.
rule_27_shortfall: No image in docs/shots/. This was a text-only judging task with no browser and no game run; the image is reported as absent rather than faked.
